message: 心配
Just like that time I saw her before, Azel was gazing up at the sky stretching above Finis Tower.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Synn
message: 「You weren't in the library, so I figured you'd be here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Staring up there again.」
Azel didn't even try to look my way, murmuring softly.

name: Azel
message: 「...What happened to your special training.」

name: Synn
message: 「We wrapped up for today.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see...」

name: Synn
message: 「I got beaten to a pulp.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you get bored of watching?」

name: Azel
message: 「...It's pointless.」
Azel's profile, still refusing to look in my direction.
Was it only because she was bathed in the setting sun that she looked somehow sorrowful?

name: Azel
message: 「Your opponent is strong, isn't he?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. He is.」

name: Azel
message: 「You don't even have a clear grasp of just how strong he is.」

name: Synn
message: 「Embarrassing as it is.」

name: Azel
message: 「Helena said that humans progress rapidly. However, if your opponent is far stronger, you won't be able to catch up.」

name: Synn
message: 「I guess... that might be true?」

name: Azel
message: 「If you cannot catch up, you will be defeated.」

name: Azel
message: 「Defeat means death. Aren't you afraid?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Honestly, it hasn't really sunk in yet, but... I think I'll probably be scared when the time comes.」

name: Azel
message: 「Imagine it. The moment you end up dying.」

name: Azel
message: 「If you can't imagine your own death. Imagine someone else's.」

name: Azel
message: 「For example, the sight of your childhood friend, not breathing, not smiling, reduced to a mere corpse. A lump of flesh, cruelly frozen, burned raw, crushed, and half-destroyed.」
I ended up imagining it.

name: Azel
message: 「Why do you people have to fight?」
Why indeed? Still, I was certain there was no backing down.
It wasn't out of stubbornness or anything like that, it was because I knew it was the right thing to do.
As the Demon Lord? As the Student Council President?
No, as myself.
When I realized it, Azel was looking at my face.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you worried about us?」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Right, of course not.」
She looked away because she was worried.

name: Azel
message: 「Choosing danger over safety is irrational. It goes against biological instinct.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, nobody besides us knows about the demons or Re-Crea. We're the only ones who can do something about it.」

name: Azel
message: 「Aren't you scared?」

name: Synn
message: 「I am scared. But I'm together with everyone.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Do whatever you want.」
Was it just my imagination that her tone sounded somewhat lonely?
